text: {"assertions":["A broken email layout issue was identified in notifications/email/render.py after a rolling restart of the fleet on 2026-01-19.","The broken layout occurred when rendering the digest template with a long subject line.","The root cause was an exception being silently caught and swallowed by a bare except clause.","The symptom was a table overflowing in the plain text part of the email rendering.","The fix involved narrowing the exception handler and allowing the failure to propagate, implemented in PR #5143 on branch fix/broken-layout-1.","The nightly email rollup successfully matched source counts for 21 consecutive days after the fix was applied.","This issue occurred in the same area of notifications/email/render.py as earlier broken layout work, allowing technical context to carry over."]}
